notes: Your kit no longer queues two memories about different things as a conflict, and when a newer memory plainly updates an older one it settles that on the spot instead of waiting for the night.
Your kit now reads long notes all the way through when it learns who and what they mention, not just their opening.
Recall no longer tells your agents there is no answer when the answer is right in front of them.
Your kit's soul keeps growing on models that like to think first; before, it could quietly write nothing.
Imports finish faster and each night costs less, with recall held where it was.
The night drops a stage that only wrote to a log, and the dream bar no longer shows it.
The nightly sleep report is no longer mistaken for a memory that could contradict your others.
